text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne up on CBOT soycomplex calls, oversold sentiments. July WCE futures crush margin fell to -2.09 Tuesday from +0.34 Monday. Canada's dollar was firmer at C$1.3834 versus the U.S. dollar but fell to 83.59 yen and 1.2291 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 a tonne higher on allied markets with commercials expected to buy.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.40 up in old crop July which closed C$3 a tonne down at its contract low.
Support was seen coming after the July-Oct barley spread closed at $1.70, CBOT corn calls were higher but seeding progressed at a good pace in Alberta at 64 percent complete.
FEED WHEAT - Mixed. C$0.50 down in old crop to reallign spreads after the July-Dec was offered at C$1 but closed at C$0.50 and C$0.50 up in new crop.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
